ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and track the money to determine the extent of the issue.
questions: What is the extent of the alleged Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale issue with Medicaid funding in Minnesota. By following the money, we can determine the extent of the alleged fraud and identify those responsible.
